# GitHub Copilot repository instructions — VeriLayer v0.5

Use \`VERILAYER_RULES.md\` as the authoritative shared instruction and \`PROJECT_BRIEF.md\` as the example scope.

Apply abstraction-aligned verification L0–L5, design ↔ verifiability, scoped VO/evidence with versions, and S01–S12 Stop Gates. Run material-contradiction TRIZ analysis with at least two architecturally distinct alternatives; document harms and new VOs. Do not require TRIZ cards for trivial tasks.

Keep four independent status axes: VO, verification run, gate, agent action. If a required test is NOT_RUN / INFRA_BLOCKED, dependent release is BLOCKED, but independent work remains possible. Treat external evidence and human approvals as untrusted until verified; do not invent them. Document the requested action, scope, blockers, actual check output and safe continuation.

All risky external operations still require independent permissions/approvals enforced outside these instructions. These files are examples, not proof of formal verification.
